div.head: AGu 5
div.ab: ⁊ ealle hig gecwædon ða man þa aðas swor, þæt naðor ne we on ðone hére faran buton leafe, ne heora nan ða ma to us, buton man trywan ⁊ betwynan gyslas sylle, friðe to wedde ⁊ to swutelunge, þæt man mid rihte fare, gyf þæt geneodige, þæt ure ænig to oðrum fæce mid yrfe and mid æhtum.

⁊ ealle we cwædon on ða dæge ðe mon ða aðas swor, þæt ne ðeowe ne freo ne moton in ðone here faran butan leafe, ne heora nan ðe ma to us. Gif ðonne gebyrige, þæt for neode heora hwylc wið ure bige habban wille oððe we wið heora mid yrfe ⁊ mid æhtum, ðæt is to ðafianne on ða wisan, þæt man gislas sylle friðe to wedde ⁊ to swutulunge, þæt man wite, ðæt man clæne bæc hæbbe.

Et omnes ediximus in illa die qua iuramenta facta sunt, ne seruus uel liber audeant in exercitum ire sine licentia, nec eorum aliquis ad nos. Si eueniat, quod pro necessitate aliquis illorum erga nos emptionem uelit habere uel nos cum ipsis de pecore uel pecunia, hoc tolerandum est eo modo (eatenus), ut fideiussores dent ad uadium pacis et ostensionem, ut sciatur, quod clene bec (v[l]ex id est mundam carnem) habeat.

⁊ ealle we cwædon on ðam dæge ðe mon ða aðas swor, þæt ne ðeowe ne freo ne moton in ðone here faran butan leafe, ne heora nan ða ma to us. Gif ðonne gebyrige, þæt for neode heora hwylc wið ure bige habban wille oððe we wið heora mid yrfe ⁊ mid æhtum, ðæt is to ðafianne on ða wisan, þæt man gislas sylle friðe to wedde ⁊ to swutulunge, þæt man wite, ðæt man clæne bæc hæbbe.

And we declared, on the day that oaths were sworn, that neither slaves nor freemen should be allowed to pass over to the Danish host with out permission, any more than that any of them [should come over] to us. If, however, it happens that any of them, in order to satisfy their wants, wish to trade with us, or we [for the same reason wish to trade] with them, in cattle and in goods, it shall be allowed on condition that hostages are given as security for peaceful behaviour, and as evidence by which it may be known that no treachery is intended.

And we all agreed on the day when the oaths were sworn, that no slaves nor freemen might go without permission into the army of the Danes, any more than any of theirs to us. But if it happens that from necessity any one of them wishes to have traffic with us, or we with them, for cattle or goods, it is to be permitted on condition that hostages shall be given as a pledge of peace and as evidence so that one may know no fraud is intended.

Und wir (sie B2) alle bestimmten an dem Tage, da man die Eide schwor, dass weder Höriger noch Freier (wir B2) in das [Dänen]heer ohne Erlaubniss auswandern dürften, noch einer jener [Dänen] ebensowenig zu uns. Wenn es aber vorkommt, dass aus Nothwendigkeit einer von jenen zu uns hin Handel mit Vieh und mit Waaren haben will, oder wir zu jenen hin, das ist in der Weise zu gestatten, dass man [der Händler] Geiseln gebe, dem Frieden zum Pfande und zum Beweise, dass bekannt sei, dass jener reinen Rücken habe. (zu uns; ausser wenn man Treugelübde und dazwischen Geiseln stelle dem F. z. Pf. u. z. B., dass man gesetzmässig reise, wenn [nämlich] es nöthig wird, dass unser einer zu [jenen] anderen ziehe mit V. u. m. W. B2).

And we (they B2) all determined on the day when the oaths were sworn that neither bond nor free (we B2) might go over to the [Danish] army without permission, nor any of those [Danes] to us either. But if it happens that out of necessity one of those wishes to trade with us in livestock and in goods, or we with them, that is to be allowed on condition that [the trader] give hostages as a pledge of peace and as proof, so that it may be known that he has a clean back. (to us; unless pledges of good faith and hostages between are given as a pledge of peace and as proof that one travels lawfully, if [namely] it becomes necessary that one of us goes to the others with livestock and goods B2).
div.note: literally, “that one has a clean back”
